summary: An off-hand dagger that adds +1 AC and Chills attackers who miss.

fields.Cold rider: A non-thrown hit also deals 1d4 Cold damage.
fields.Chilling Counter: In the off hand, missed attacks against you apply Chilled for 2 turns. The tooltip lists DC 13 Constitution, but the pinned rule reports no save. Chilled gives Cold vulnerability and Fire resistance. Applying Wet after Chilled can Freeze for 1 turn.
fields.Off-hand AC: +1 AC while equipped in the off hand.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
